title: Misgendering and Assuming Gender in Machine Translation when Working with Low-Resource Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Discursive commentary and review of prior empirical translation tests (using single-occupation and action-based prompts) to evaluate occupational stereotyping, misgendering, and the linguistic erasure of non-binary pronouns in machine translation.

Qualitative and sociotechnical analysis of the hierarchical treatment of low-resource languages, evaluating the ethnolinguistic flattening and colonial imposition of high-resource language structures (English) onto languages like Bengali.
